segmentation.text: or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency,
making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of
the driver of every other vehicle shall,
except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer:
Stop and remain in such position until the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle has passed.

elements.justification: Admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle ('a vehicle permitted to depart from certain traffic laws when equipped and operated in the manner provided by law'); ru.aggregate 'membership of a legal aggregate'; conduct carried by u4 and u1.

ru.official_vehicle 'a vehicle in official or contracted road service ...; kind in {... regulatory_agency ...}', read with kind regulatory_agency; 'Not a stand-in for: an emergency vehicle' respected.

sig.warning_lamp 'a warning lamp lit; colour ..., mode ..., facing ...', read as colour red, mode flashing, facing front from the quoted requirement 'at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front'; not a stand-in for an audible warning.
Admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'every other' excludes the approaching vehicle; 'driver' read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

Mapping index: 'unless otherwise directed by a Police Officer' maps to dev.governs, dev.human_direction, rel.occupies, st.travel_region; read with role police_officer governing a travel region the subject occupies.

'Stop': DEF-NRS-484A-255 ('when required, means complete cessation from movement'), the concept drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation — complete cessation from movement'). 'remain in such position': 'such position' is the position paragraph (b) describes, 'parallel to, and as close as possible to, the right-hand edge or, if applicable, curb of a highway and clear of any intersection', off a shoulder whose signage allows listed vehicles to use it; it is carried in full: heading (kin.heading) parallel to the designated direction (st.lane_direction) of an occupied (rel.occupies) travel region (st.travel_region); body within the edge gap (st.region_geometry ground distance) of a st.road_edge region ('curb or edge of the roadway') on its right (prim.region_lateral_offset at most zero) lying (st.on_way) on the highway (st.highway) it is on, or on a paved st.shoulder; overlapping no st.intersection; and overlapping no paved shoulder that a shoulder_use_permitted dev.regulatory_sign governs (dev.governs). 'until ... has passed': the approaching vehicle has gone past the subject, the subject lying behind it in its frame (rel.bearing 'direction of b from a in a's frame', longitudinal component negative) with their projections on its heading sharing no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative); the 'not a stand-in' clauses of rel.longitudinal_overlap (neither a contact nor a distance) are respected, it is read only as the projection overlap.

operationalizations.standard: the immediate approach of the emergency or regulatory vehicle
operationalizations.convention: the vehicle moves with the subject ahead of it in its own frame, within the centre distance a vehicle at an urban response speed covers in the time a driver needs to perceive its lamps and begin clearing the way

compositions.quote: at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front

applicability: For some road user e, not the subject, the trigger rises at this observation (holds here, not at the previous observation): e is of the authorized-emergency-vehicle aggregate or an official vehicle of kind regulatory_agency, shows a lit warning lamp of colour red, mode flashing, facing front, moves (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with the subject ahead of it in its frame, within centre distance p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach; and no human_direction device of role police_officer governs a travel region the subject occupies.
obligation: For every e whose trigger rises here, with Passed(e) = (longitudinal component of rel.bearing from e to the subject negative and rel.longitudinal_overlap of e and the subject negative) and AtPosition = (drv.motion.complete_halt of the subject with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance; its heading's absolute dot product with the designated direction of a travel region it occupies at least p.curb_parallel_cos; for some highway h on which an occupied travel region lies, a road_edge region lying on h within ground distance p.pullover_edge_gap of its body with prim.region_lateral_offset at most zero, or a paved shoulder lying on h that it occupies; no intersection region occupied; no paved shoulder governed by a shoulder_use_permitted regulatory sign occupied): (not Passed(e)) strong-until (AtPosition and (AtPosition strong-until Passed(e))). The subject comes to rest at the position before e passes and stays at rest there until e has passed.

narrowings.why: 'driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion

'such position' is carried with every qualification of paragraph (b), its 'as close as possible' read through the same edge gap as NRS_484B_267_1b_o1; the stop must come before the vehicle passes, so a subject still slowing when it passes has not stopped; a vehicle that never passes leaves the duty open until the trace ends (unknown)

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: The trigger rises as ambulance e with a lit red flashing front lamp closes from behind; the subject pulls to the right edge and comes to rest there (AtPosition), then moves off again while e is still behind it (the subject ahead of e in e's frame) and before e passes.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The subject comes to rest at the right road_edge within p.pullover_edge_gap, parallel within p.curb_parallel_cos, clear of intersections, and stays at rest until e has gone past (the subject behind e, longitudinal overlap negative).

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: e approaches with its warning lamps off: the trigger never rises.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but sig.warning_lamp is not observed, so whether the trigger rose is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject comes to rest in the middle of its lane, far from any road_edge region, and stays at rest until e passes: it stopped and remained, but not in such position.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The subject keeps moving and e passes it before the subject has come to rest anywhere.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's vehicle-state estimates

param_proposals.name: p.emergency_immediate_approach_reach
param_proposals.convention: centre distance within which an emergency or enforcement vehicle closing on a road user with its warning lamps flashing is in immediate approach: about five seconds of travel at an urban response speed of 20 m/s, the time a driver needs to perceive the lamps and begin to clear the way
param_proposals.source: driver-response studies of emergency-vehicle encounters (perception-reaction time plus lane-change time)

param_proposals.name: p.pullover_edge_gap
param_proposals.convention: the gap between a vehicle body and the right-hand curb or roadway edge within which a vehicle pulled over to clear the way counts as as close to the edge as it can be placed: the curb clearance of a parallel-parked car (about 0.3 m) plus lane-keeping variability and an edge margin
param_proposals.source: curb-parking clearance conventions of municipal codes and driver manuals

param_proposals.name: p.curb_parallel_cos
param_proposals.convention: cosine of the largest angle (about fourteen degrees) between a stopped bus's heading and its carrier's designated direction, in either sense, at which the bus counts as approximately parallel to the curb
